description: Use when creating secondary windows, implementing splashscreen flows, or communicating between windows in Tauri 2. Prevents duplicate window label panics and orphaned window handles from missing lifecycle cleanup. Covers creating windows from Rust and JavaScript, inter-window events, show/hide patterns, splashscreen, and parent-child relationships. Keywords: tauri multi-window, secondary window, splashscreen, inter-window communication, window lifecycle, parent-child.
